remarks: Great opportunity to own a brand-new triplex in central Edmonton, situated on a desirable corner lot! This multifamily property features 15 bedrooms, 12 bathrooms, and 6 self-contained living spaces, including 3 main residences and 3 legal basement suites. Each main residence offers 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a spacious living area, dining space, and a functional kitchen. Each basement suite includes 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and its own kitchen and living area. With approximately 5,000 sq. ft. of total developed living space, including 3,240 sq. ft. above grade, this property offers modern layouts and plenty of space. (id:67522)
